definitions.explanation: An interdisciplinary academic field that studies the relationship between human activity and the natural environment, encompassing ecology, conservation, pollution, and sustainability.

examples.japanese: {環境学|かんきょうがく}を{学|まな}んでいる。
{大学|だいがく}で{環境学|かんきょうがく}を{専攻|せんこう}するつもりだ。
examples.english: I plan to major in environmental studies at university.

examples.japanese: {環境学|かんきょうがく}の{視点|してん}から{見|み}ると、この{開発|かいはつ}{計画|けいかく}には{多|おお}くの{問題|もんだい}がある。
examples.english: From an environmental studies perspective, this development plan has many problems.

notes:
Combines {環境|かんきょう} (environment) and {学|がく} (study/science). A relatively modern academic discipline that has grown in importance as environmental issues like {地球|ちきゅう}{温暖化|おんだんか} (global warming) and {生態系|せいたいけい}{破壊|はかい} (ecosystem destruction) have become major concerns.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {環境学|かんきょうがく}{部|ぶ}: Department of Environmental Studies
- {環境学|かんきょうがく}の{研究|けんきゅう}: environmental studies research
- {環境学|かんきょうがく}を{専攻|せんこう}する: to major in environmental studies
- {環境学|かんきょうがく}{入門|にゅうもん}: introduction to environmental studies

RELATED WORDS:
- {環境|かんきょう}{問題|もんだい}: environmental issues
- {環境|かんきょう}{保護|ほご}: environmental protection
- {生態学|せいたいがく}: ecology
